diagram_title: PatentWorks Analysis Boundary — C4 Component Diagram

systems.name: PatentWorks
systems.description: PatentDrafter current-state package composed of patentmcp retrieval tools and patentworks skill flows.

containers.name: Retrieval MCP Layer
containers.description: Patent data search, full-text retrieval, table building, and handle delivery.

containers.name: Skill Flow Layer
containers.description: Patent practitioner workflows for disclosure, screening, analysis, and drafting.

containers.name: Specbase Layer
containers.description: Architecture SSOT and implementation planning artifacts.

containers.name: Reference Layer
containers.description: Patent practitioner workflow and jurisdiction-specific drafting knowledge.

components.name: PatentWorks Skill Router
components.description: Routes user intent to disclosure, screening, or drafting; analysis routing is planned.

components.name: Screening Flow
components.description: Builds and enriches agent-friendly human-readable scored CSV outputs from retrieval materials.

components.name: Analysis Boundary
components.description: Planned source-agnostic layer for feature extraction, element mapping, differences, drafting basis, and review flags.

components.name: Drafting Flow
components.description: Consumes analysis basis plus jurisdiction knowledge to draft claims, specification, and abstract.

components.name: Practitioner Workflow Reference
components.description: Defines patent search, screening, analysis, and report practices.

components.name: Architecture SSOT
components.description: Records current PatentWorks boundaries and planned analysis separation.

components.name: Analysis Refactor Plan
components.description: Execution-ready plan package for implementing the analysis boundary.

relationships.description: provides retrieval rows, full text handles, and screening table handles
hands shortlist or enriched row materials to analysis
provides drafting basis, differences, features, and review flags
